title: 第2477章 秘境之变第2476章 只是略强一些
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 小子龙和曦儿已经进入秘境中五年之久，这五年以来一直没有任何变故，然而这一日，圣宗深处却蓦然传出一道闷响，整个圣宗都似是在摇晃。
在相隔不远的两个院落中，道门圣女在打坐修炼，洛流香则在研究莫阳送给她那柄寒铁祭炼的战剑，而此时，两人皆是被这一道闷响同时惊到，随后相继腾空而起，直接掠向圣宗深处。
因为那道闷响传来的方向正是小子龙和曦儿进入的那方秘境。
而此时莫阳正和季飞尘以及徐青在一起，圣宗这两个天才面对莫阳这个准帝境的强者，修炼途中的疑问都一股脑抛给莫阳，半月的时间，两人皆是受益颇丰。
季飞尘和徐青原本都准备要去闭关了，但不曾想圣宗深处突然传来一道闷响，似是虚空崩碎那般，震得整个圣宗都在抖动。
徐青和季飞尘都猛然起身看向声响传来的方向，徐青当即笑了起来，开口道：“是秘境的方向，两个小家伙倒是会找时候，若是再晚两天，我都要去闭关了……”
“五年了，不知道这大侄子大侄女磨炼得怎么样了！”季飞尘也开口，说话之时，身躯已经腾空朝着秘境的方向掠去了。
秘境的方向传来这等动静，十有八九是秘境开启了，与之相关的自然只有小子龙和曦儿了。
莫阳自然第一时间就想到了两个小家伙，只是他并没有第一时间跟上去，而是眉头微皱，隐隐感觉有些不对劲。
他虽然没有动身，但庞大的神念瞬息间已经入潮水般涌出，瞬间将整个圣宗都笼罩在内，第一时间感应到了那里发生的一切。
动静确实是从秘境中传出来的，只是秘境却没有开启，而是被一股力量击穿了，小子龙和曦儿也没有出现，只是一角染血的衣袍被打了出来。
在莫阳捕捉到这一切后，神念感应中才看到洛流香和道门圣女飞落在那里，随后是圣宗的其他强者……
而飞落而下的圣宗强者以及洛流香和道门圣女此时都全部愣住，一道道目光都落在那角染血的衣袍上，随即人人脸色大变。
一个念头从所有人脑海中闪过，秘境中出现了变故！
洛流香第一时间回神，还不等其他强者出手，她便抬手一挥，直接将那角染血的衣袍摄取到手中，随即失声惊呼道：“是子龙的衣袍！”
那衣袍是她亲手缝制，她不可能认错。
“到底发生了什么，人呢，难道是秘境中出现了未知变故？”一位圣宗强者低呼。
徐青和季飞尘此时也飞落而下，同样脸色骤变，两人没有迟疑，急忙开口道：“赶紧合力将秘境轰开！”
说罢在场的众人才猛然回神，随后都齐齐出手，一股股强大的气息透发而出，数十道强大的力量霎时间轰落在秘境所在之地，虚空直接被崩碎了一大片，然而根本就没有秘境的影子。
“不好，秘境中出现变故，如今只怕已经隐于虚无间了！”一位圣宗的老者惊呼。
这是所有人都没有料到的事情，当初将小子龙和曦儿送进去，圣宗给他们准备了诸多手段，确保他们纵然有危险也能击穿秘境离开，谁想事情竟然会变成这样。
道门圣女和洛流香脑海中一片空白，两人还在拼命出手，一道道强大的力量将那方虚空不断崩开，但也仅仅如此。
“莫兄呢？两位嫂子别急，我去找莫兄，他定然有办法！”此时徐青焦急的朝四周看了一眼，接而开口说道。
不过还未等他动身，莫阳便已经来了，身影无声无息出现在前方，头也不会的开口道：“先退后！”
在场的圣宗强者都已经知晓莫阳归来的事情，此时闻言，都下意识的往后退去，连季飞尘和徐青都不例外，因为他们很清楚，这秘境不简单，乃远古年间便存在的，他们根本帮不上忙。
content_en:
Xiao Zilong and Xi'er have been in the secret realm for five years, and nothing has happened in the past five years. However, on this day, a muffled sound suddenly came from the depths of the Holy Sect, and the entire Holy Sect seemed to be shaking.
In two courtyards not far apart, the Taoist saint was meditating and practicing, while Luo Liuxiang was studying the cold iron sacrificial sword that Mo Yang gave her. At this time, both of them were shocked by the muffled sound at the same time, and then they jumped into the air one after another and flew directly into the depths of the Holy Sect.
Because the direction that the muffled sound came from was the secret realm that Xiao Zilong and Xi'er entered.
At this time, Mo Yang was with Ji Feichen and Xu Qing. Facing Mo Yang, a strong man in the quasi-emperor realm, the two geniuses of Shengzong threw all the questions they had during their training at Mo Yang. In half a month, both of them benefited a lot.
Ji Feichen and Xu Qing were originally going to retreat, but they never thought that a muffled sound suddenly came from the depths of the Holy Sect, as if the void was shattering, shaking the entire Holy Sect.
Xu Qing and Ji Feichen both stood up suddenly and looked towards the direction of the sound. Xu Qing immediately laughed and said: "It's the direction of the secret realm. The two little guys will find the time. If it's two days later, I will go to retreat..."
"It's been five years. I wonder how my nephew and niece have been training!" Ji Feichen also spoke. As he spoke, his body was already flying towards the secret realm.
When such movement came from the direction of the secret realm, it was most likely that the secret realm had been opened, and naturally the only ones related to it were Xiao Zilong and Xi'er.
Naturally, Mo Yang immediately thought of the two little guys, but he did not follow them immediately. Instead, he frowned slightly, feeling that something was wrong.
Although he didn't move, his huge spiritual thoughts surged out like a tide in an instant, instantly enveloping the entire Holy Sect, and he immediately sensed everything that happened there.
The movement did come from the secret realm, but the secret realm was not opened, but was penetrated by a force. Xiao Zilong and Xi'er did not appear, but a corner of the blood-stained robe was punched out.
After Mo Yang captured all this, he saw Luo Liuxiang and the Taoist saint flying down there, followed by other strong men from the Holy Sect...
The strong man from the Holy Sect, Luo Liuxiang and the Taoist saint who were flying down were all stunned at this moment. Their eyes fell on the blood-stained robes, and then everyone's expressions changed drastically.
A thought flashed through everyone's mind, something happened in the secret realm!
Luo Liuxiang came to her senses immediately. Before other strong men could take action, she raised her hand and took the blood-stained robe directly into her hand. Then she exclaimed, "It's Zilong's robe!"
The robe was sewn by her own hands, so there was no way she could admit it was wrong.
"What exactly happened? Where are you? Is there something unknown happening in the secret realm?" A strong man from the Holy Sect whispered.
Xu Qing and Ji Feichen also flew down at this time, and their expressions also changed suddenly. Without hesitation, they hurriedly said: "Hurry up and work together to blast away the secret realm!"
After saying this, everyone present suddenly came to their senses, and then they all took action, powerful auras came out, and dozens of powerful forces suddenly hit the place where the secret realm was. The void was directly shattered into a large area, but there was no shadow of the secret realm at all.
"No, something happened in the secret realm, and now I'm afraid it has disappeared into nothingness!" An old man from the Holy Sect exclaimed.
This is something that no one expected. When Xiao Zilong and Xi'er were sent in, the Holy Sect prepared many means for them to ensure that they could break through the secret realm and leave even if they were in danger. Who would have thought that things would turn out like this.
The minds of the Taoist saint and Luo Liuxiang went blank. They were still trying their best to attack. Powerful forces continued to collapse the void, but that was all.
"Where's Brother Mo? Sisters-in-law, don't worry. I'll go find Brother Mo. He will definitely have a solution!" At this time, Xu Qing glanced around anxiously and then said.
But before he could move, Mo Yang had already arrived, his figure appeared in front of him silently, and he said without even turning his head: "Back off first!"
All the Saint Sect experts present already knew about Mo Yang's return. When they heard this, they all subconsciously stepped back, even Ji Feichen and Xu Qing were no exception, because they knew very well that this secret realm was not simple, it had existed in ancient times, and they could not help at all.
